description: Build a paid enhanced due diligence memo for a subject and its wallets: exact-match OFAC wallet screening, subject-name screening against sanctioned parties, sanctions evidence, and follow-up actions, returned as structured JSON or an inline PDF/DOCX artifact. Use this for case handoff; use wallet_screen for screening-only results.

addresses.description: Crypto wallet addresses to screen for OFAC sanctions exposure and include in the enhanced due diligence memo.

items.description: Crypto wallet address to screen for OFAC sanctions exposure and include in the enhanced due diligence memo.

artifact_only.description: When output_format is pdf or docx, return a compact artifact-first response without the full memo payload.

asset.description: Optional asset or network ticker filter such as ETH, USDC, XBT, TRX, ARB, or BSC.

case_name.description: Optional case or review title shown in the memo.

case_reference.description: Optional case reference to file the saved result under.

jurisdiction.description: Optional jurisdiction or operating region for the case.

lists.description: Sanctions lists to screen against. Defaults to ["ofac_sdn"]. Optional additions: "ofac_consolidated" (OFAC's non-SDN lists), "uk_sanctions" (UK Sanctions List), "eu_consolidated" (EU consolidated financial sanctions list) and "un_consolidated" (UN Security Council list). The UK and EU lists name only a few wallet addresses and the UN list none, so those three mostly matter for subject-name screening in compliance_edd_report. Every match names its list. If a requested list cannot be loaded the call fails instead of returning a partial result.

output_format.description: Select json for the structured memo payload or pdf|docx for a generated artifact.

reference_id.description: Optional internal case or review reference.

requested_by.description: Optional requester, owner, or reviewing team.

review_reason.description: Optional reason the EDD memo is being prepared.

save.description: Keep this result in your account so it can be retrieved later with saved_results. Needs sign-in or an API key; off by default.

subject_aliases.description: Other names the subject is known by; each is also screened against sanctioned party names and aliases.

subject_name.description: Human-readable subject or counterparty name for the memo.

name: compliance_edd_report

outputSchema.description: Structured response object returned by the tool in structuredContent.

artifact.description: Inline generated file artifact. The service does not persist a hosted download URL.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded artifact content to decode and save locally.

name.description: Suggested file name for the artifact.

type.description: Artifact document type such as pdf or docx.

artifact_summary.description: Delivery and rendering metadata for an inline generated artifact.

delivery.description: How to retrieve or save the generated artifact.

downloadUrl.description: Hosted download URL when one exists; null when the artifact is inline only.

documentType.description: Rendered artifact type such as pdf or docx.

fileName.description: Suggested file name for the generated artifact.

artifacts.description: Artifact rendering hints keyed by format.

data.description: Primary structured result payload for the tool.

error.description: Machine-readable error code or message when the tool fails.

output.description: Nested renderer output when a workflow bundles an artifact render.

anyOf.description: Report-shaped payload with summary, metrics, tables, or evidence.
Null when no saved report is available.

report.description: Report-shaped payload when available; null for status-only retrieval responses.

anyOf.description: Source route, dataset, or execution metadata for the result.

source.description: Source label, route, dataset, or execution metadata for the result.

title: EDD Report
